description: This file is a unit test class for the FeaturePropertyModified class, testing immutability, equals/hashCode, null argument handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and creation of instances for that class.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyModifiedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for FeaturePropertyModified, focusing on serialization, immutability, and null arguments.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that FeaturePropertyModified instances are immutable and their associated Json classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies hashCode and equals implementations of FeaturePropertyModified using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturePropertyModified with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyJsonPointer
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturePropertyModified with a null JSON property pointer throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPropertyValue
methods.description: Tests that creating FeaturePropertyModified with a null property value throws NullPointerException.
